The paths of DERIVED files — whoever conflicts in them rebuilds.

```text
Prints the patterns of the files that Anchors generates.

Whoever resolves a conflict uses this to tell NOISE from DIVERGENCE: in a generated
file, rebuilding produces the right answer; in a work file, two people
wrote different things and only they decide.

    anchors generated-paths              # one per line
    anchors generated-paths --format re  # as a regex alternation, for grep

The list comes from the PRODUCT, not from constants repeated in each project's script.
It is a single source: when a path changes, every project follows.
```

## Uso

```bash
anchors generated-paths [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Padrão | O que faz |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--format` | `lines` | `lines` (one per line) or `re` (alternation, for grep -E) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

| [`anchors renumber`](/pt/docs/cli/commands/renumber/) | Renumber the revisions this branch added when the base already took their number |
| **`anchors generated-paths`** | The paths of DERIVED files — whoever conflicts in them rebuilds |
